exemptions.reason: Denial of service when parsing JWKs that contain RSA keys. The GitHub advisory lists go-jose/v3 up to 3.0.5 with no patched version (first_patched_version null); the only fix is in go-jose/v4 4.1.6, a different module path. Grype reports fix state not-fixed for this package. Reachability in the demo edge is not established here. Revisit when a go-jose/v3 fix or a dependency move removes it.

No fix: the Red Hat record for RHEL 9 lists no fixed build (Grype fix state not-fixed). Exploiting it needs the process to parse attacker-supplied XML. The only package that links libexpat apart from expat itself is dbus-broker, which is not run here; mysqld and its plugins do not link it and a running server maps none. Revisit when UBI ships an expat fix.

No fix: the Red Hat record for RHEL 9 lists no fixed build (Grype fix state not-fixed). The flaw is in GnuPG for Windows (insecure default DACL on the shared program data directory); this image is Linux, so the affected code does not exist here. gnupg2 is present only as a dependency of gpgme, which the package manager uses to check package signatures; the server never runs gpg.

No fix: the Red Hat record for RHEL 9 lists no fixed build (Grype fix state not-fixed). The mount(8) race needs an /etc/fstab entry with the user or users option and a local unprivileged user; the image has no /etc/fstab and the server runs as the mysql user with no mount privilege. The util-linux libraries are listed one by one because Grype reports each; a running mysqld maps none of them.
